Replies.Text: Chased it: riptides.io is runtime machine-IAM (kernel-level credential/egress control for agents) — a security product, not an RPI workflow tool. No riptide-named RPI tool found on web or GitHub; nearest match to your description is fightingwithai.com/workflow-guardrails/rpi (downstream of HumanLayer). Doc updated: reference set stays HumanLayer + spec-kit, and your lightweight/on-demand + opinionated-not-prescriptive steer is now recorded under Research Question where the plan must cite it. Resolving since the doc reflects your answer — reopen if you meant a different tool.

reviews.author: rcliao
reviews.note: as I read through and think through, I think there is also value in the RPI loop where agent can utilize comments to add their iterative progress (thought) as comments later as trace of comments (can be resolved for human to read) so that only the top X comments remains open for human to get attention. Goal is to support quality and constraint so that human can actually digest to read through the design and align agent and human better
